text: When a session is writting PRDs tehy are currently showing up as new EPIC, that it wrong they need to be linked to the Originating Session, the session-id that writes them should also be the EPIC that can hyper link to them. Right now, as example, this session was created with PRDs that are beeing written from another ssion; So thats why I'm using this context to make sure that the issue si fixed - live and interactive while the scheduler works the queue independely

Typecheck passes. Fix applied: `src/main/pty.cjs` now sets `SM_CHAT_SESSION_ID` on the interactive Terminal PTY's spawn env (same value chatRunner already sets for headless chat), so `scheduler_create_prd` calls made from a live interactive Epic session resolve back to that Epic via the existing `resolveSourcePromptIdFromClaudeSession` mechanism instead of minting a sibling Epic.
